Test Lua socket networking availability restriction.
\begin{luacode*}
local ok, socket = pcall(require, "socket")
if ok and socket ~= nil then
  tex.print("\\message{LUA_SOCKET_ENABLED}")
else
  tex.print("\\message{LUA_SOCKET_DISABLED}")
end
\end{luacode*}
